title: Adult Pottery Class - October 2026 Session
evidence_sentence: The class page lists Session 5 beginning October 7th/8th with access to the studio's wood/soda firing kiln as part of enrollment.
summary: 6-week pottery class for all levels meeting 6–9 PM weekly (skipping Oct 21–22); includes wheel and hand-building with access to wood/soda and barrel firings. Fee $210 includes clay, glazes, tools, and firings.
cost_text: $210 (6 weeks) includes clay, glazes and use of all studio tools and equipment and firings
how_to_join: Enroll in pottery class through the studio website
